image_description: A side-profile view of a modern, custom-styled electric golf cart. The vehicle features a metallic orange/bronze body with black accents and a beige fabric canopy. It has two bucket-style seats rather than a traditional bench, a visible steering wheel, and small wheels with turf tires. The background shows a building facade with stone steps and potted plants.
